title: Missing Commercial Committee approval for material Orion contract
condition: The evidence pack includes contract C-ORION-2026-019 with total value IDR 855,000,000, but does not include Commercial Committee minutes or approval log in the initial pack.
criteria: Company revenue policy requires contracts above IDR 750,000,000 to be approved by the Commercial Committee before revenue recognition. ISA 500-style evidence readiness requires sufficient appropriate evidence supporting relevant assertions.
cause: The approval document was not uploaded with the initial evidence pack.
effect: Rights & Obligations and Occurrence coverage for the Orion contract remains incomplete. Auditor may request additional documentation before relying on the revenue evidence.
recommendation: Upload Commercial Committee minutes or signed approval log for C-ORION-2026-019.

title: Missing CFO approval for manual revenue adjustment
condition: JRN-2026-06-117 records a manual revenue acceleration adjustment of IDR 72,000,000, but the initial pack shows approved_by as MISSING.
criteria: Company revenue policy requires CFO approval for manual revenue journal entries above IDR 50,000,000.
cause: CFO approval evidence was prepared separately and omitted from the initial evidence pack.
effect: Classification, Accuracy, and Rights & Obligations assertions are not fully supported for the manual adjustment.
recommendation: Upload CFO approval evidence for JRN-2026-06-117.

title: Potential cut-off issue for Orion implementation milestone 2
condition: Invoice INV-2026-0630 was issued and recognized on 2026-06-30, while service delivery log shows production go-live on 2026-07-02.
criteria: Revenue close policy requires invoices in the last five business days of a period to be supported by acceptance evidence, usage report, or delivery log. ISA-style cut-off testing evaluates whether transactions are recorded in the correct period.
cause: Management relied on UAT sign-off before quarter-end, while production go-live occurred after quarter-end.
effect: Cut-off and Occurrence assertions for the June Orion implementation revenue require further auditor review.
recommendation: Obtain additional production readiness evidence dated on or before 2026-06-30 or consider deferring the milestone revenue.
